dkyus su thun mjug so sor bden brdar dgug gzhug mdzad pa'i phyag len ltar na/bzlas pa grub pa dang*/na mo/rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam

tei:div.tei:p: dkyus su thun mjug so sor bden brdar dgug gzhug mdzad pa'i phyag len ltar na/ bzlas pa grub pa dang*/ na mo/ rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ yi dam rgyal ba zhi khro dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags snying po phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos nyid rnam par dag cing chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa'i chen po'i mthus/ rgyal po'i pho brang*/ dge 'dun gyi kun dga' ra ba dang chos grwa chen po/ grong khyer chen po'i srang mdo/ khrom chen po'i 'du sa/ lha srin gdug rtsub gnas pa'i sa nas tshe dang ldan pa ming rus so sor smos pa'i bla tshe nyams pa dang*/ yar ba dang*/ stor ba dang*/ bros pa dang*/ 'khyams pa dang*/ gdon chen gyis 'phrog pa dang*/ gdon phran gyis brkus pa dang*/ byad ma lha srung gis bkug pa thams cad rang gnas su khug cig /ces rol mo 'gugs sngags dang bcas pa lan gsum bya/ skabs mtshams su yon bdag dngos sam bla rten gang rung gi mdun du kha gtad de bla lug chu dang bcas pa bzhag /dmod bor bas kha yon bdag gi bla rten phyogs su gtad de bsdad na khug rtags yin/ mjug gi bya bas 'thus shing log tu bsdad na cho ga sngags bzlas sogs la 'bad cing bskyar la brtag go //
